name: Amazon reviews · All Beauty
selection: First 50,000 eligible unique reviews in source order; six most-reviewed products in that pool; 20 per product selected by ascending SHA-256 of signal-v1:text:date. This convenience sample is not representative of the full category.
filters: Non-empty review text up to 2,000 characters, product ID, timestamp, rating 1–5. HTML line breaks and common/numeric entities are normalized to readable text; simple formatting tags are removed. Exact duplicate product/text/date/rating records removed. No language detection was applied.
labels: No reference sentiment labels. Star ratings are not ground truth and are not used as expected_sentiment.
